label: Neutral (no overtime rule)
source: Platform default: every hour is regular until a country or collective agreement profile is chosen.

label: Germany, construction collective agreement (BRTV Bau)
source: BRTV Bau section 3 (40 hour week, surcharges 25% overtime, 20% night, 75% Sunday, 200% public holiday); ArbZG section 3 (10 hours a day); employer social charges and SOKA-BAU levy as an indicative total.

label: United Kingdom, construction working rule agreement with CIS
source: CIJC Working Rule Agreement (39 hour week, overtime at time and a half); Working Time Regulations 1998 (48 hour average week); employer National Insurance as burden. CIS deductions apply to subcontractor payments only and are flagged, not computed here.

label: United States, FLSA overtime with prevailing wage
source: FLSA 29 USC 207 (time and a half over 40 hours a week); Davis-Bacon prevailing wage reported through certified payroll; employer FICA and unemployment taxes as an indicative burden.

label: Australia, Building and Construction General On-site Award
source: Award MA000020 (38 ordinary hours, overtime 150% for the first 2 hours then 200%, Saturday 150%, Sunday 200%, public holiday 250%); superannuation guarantee and payroll tax as burden.

label: United Arab Emirates, Labour Law (GCC overtime)
source: Federal Decree-Law 33/2021 articles 17 to 19 (8 hours a day, overtime 125%, night overtime 22:00 to 04:00 at 150%, at most 2 overtime hours a day); no employer social charge for expatriate staff.

label: Saudi Arabia, Labour Law (GCC overtime)
source: Labour Law articles 98 and 107 (8 hours a day, 48 a week, overtime at the hourly wage plus 50%); GOSI occupational hazards contribution as burden.
